paite: TOUPA a ding in bukna diklou kihhuai ahi, himahleh gikdan dik akipahpih lam ahi.
english: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.

paite: Kisaktheihna ahong pai chiang in, zumna ahong pai; himahleh mikiniamkhiakte kiang ah pilna a-om hi.
english: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

paite: Mitangte dikna in amau api ding, himahleh milepchiahte hoihlouhna in amau ahihse ding hi.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

paite: Thangpaih ni in hauhsak aphatuam kei, himahleh diktatna in sihna a kipan ahunkhia hi.
english: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

paite: Mihoihkim diktatna in alampi aseksak dia; himahleh migilou agitlouhna ah apuk ding hi.
english: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

paite: Mitangte diktatna in amau asuaktasak; himahleh lepchiahtak a hihte amau poikhoihna a lak in a-om ding uhi.
english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

paite: Migilou asih chiang in alametna amangthang ding; huan thulimlouhna lametna amangthang hi.
english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

paite: Midiktat buaina lak a kipan suahtaksak in a-om a, amun ah migilou ahong pai hi.
english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

paite: Akam a Pathian limsak lou mi'n a-inveng ahihsia a; himahleh theihna ziak in midiktat suahtaksak in a-om hi.
english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

paite: Midiktat alamzan chiang in, khopi akipak a; gilou amanthat chiang in, kikouna a-om hi.
english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

paite: Mitang vualzawlna ziak in khopi tawisang in a-om; himahleh migilou kam a hihsiat in a-om hi.
english: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

paite: Kuapeuh a-inveng musit pilna bei ahi; himahleh theisiammi adai dide hi.
english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

paite: Tangthu genmi bang a vialvak in thuguk ataklang; himahleh lungsim muanhuai in thu a-im hi.
english: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

paite: Kipina pil omlouhna mun ah mite apuk ua; himahleh thupha gen tampi omna ah bitna a-om hi.
english: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

paite: Kuapeuh mikhual a dia amoh khu dia dingh in na asa ding, himahleh moh khu dia dinna hua amuang hi.
english: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

paite: Numei deihhuai in zahtakhuaina anei gige; huan pasal hatte'n hauhsakna anei gige hi.
english: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

paite: Michingthei in amah kha a ding in ahihhoih a; himahleh migilou in ama sa ahihbuai hi.
english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

paite: Migilou in loh gina sang lou a; himahleh diktatna tuh in kipahman muan anei hi.
english: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

paite: Kuapeuh diktatna a dingkip in hinna atungding; huan kuapeuh gilou delh in ama sihna ding in ahih ahi.
english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

paite: Alungtang ua hoihloute TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi ua; himahleh alampi ua hoihkimte akipahna ahi.
english: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

paite: Khut kilen mah le uh, migilou gawt louh in a-om kei ding; himahleh diktat chi suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

paite: Vok nak sung a dangka-eng suang bang in, huchibang in numei melhoih ngentelna nei lou ahi.
english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

paite: Midiktat deihlam hoih kia ahi a; himahleh migilou lametna thangpaihna ahi.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

paite: Athehzak a-om a, apung semsem hi; akilawm kheng a it a-om a, himahleh taksap lam amanoh lel hi.
english: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

paite: Misiam thausak in a-om ding, huan kuapeuh tuibuak amah leng tui buah in a-om ding hi.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

paite: Kuapeuh buh-le-bal it, mite'n amah ahamsiat ding uh; himahleh kuapeuh azuaktu luzang ah vualzawlna a-om ding hi.
english: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

paite: Kuapeuh hoih thanuamtak a zong in deihsakna azong; himahleh kuapeuh siatna zong, amah tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

paite: Kuapeuh ahauhsakna muang apuk ding; himahleh nah hing bang in midiktat alun ding hi.
english: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

paite: Kuapeuh ama inn hihbuai in huih aluah ding; huan mihai lungtang pil sikha in a-om ding hi.
english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

paite: Midiktat gah hinna sing ahi; kuapeuh apil in khate aman hi.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

paite: Ngai in, midiktatte lei ah thuk in a-om ding. Migilou leh mikhial kinak thuksem na'n chia!
english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
